summary: PRA Group, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results and announcing a new share repurchase program approved by the Board on August 3, 2026. The program authorizes repurchases of up to $150 million of common stock through open-market, privately negotiated, block transactions, or Rule 10b5-1 trading plans, subject to market conditions and covenants. No specific price per share, premium, or expiration date was stated. Repurchases are discretionary and may be modified or suspended. Watch for execution pace and impact on EPS and leverage ratios.
